add_new_contact: add a new contact with first name, last name, and optional fields like gender, age, and email
get_contacts: get a paginated list of all contacts with metadata including total count and range
get_contact: get a single contact by its contact ID and return all stored fields
edit_contact: edit an existing contact by contact ID using a JSON updates object with field changes
search_contacts: search contacts by a query string that matches first or last name
